metaDescription: Documentation of how the Gian-I Media portfolio was designed and built, from its first concept through versions 0.5 to 1.0.

sections.metaDescription: An introduction to Gian-I Media, a growing archive of client work, personal projects, and reflections, and its temple-themed branding.

blocks.metaDescription: Meet Gian-I, a multidisciplinary graphic designer moving into product design, and explore the temple-themed branding of Gian-I Media.

sections.metaDescription: Building the first version of Gian-I Media in React, modelled on Novak’s Hypermedia Navigator, with a layered filtering system.

blocks.metaDescription: Learning React after internship feedback, and building the entire Gian-I Media site from one HTML file with React and React Router.
A portfolio layout modelled on Marcos Novak’s Hypermedia Navigator, framed as a dream space with a persistent filtering navigator.
Four layers of filtering that scale with a growing project archive, with filter settings that persist across navigation.
Plans after version 0.5: finish the remaining works, redesign the filters for mobile, and move the site to Next.js.

sections.metaDescription: Version 0.6 of Gian-I Media adds three new projects, bringing the archive to six works out of a planned ten.

blocks.metaTitle: Putting My Best Foot Forward – Version 0.6 – Birth
blocks.metaDescription: Three new projects bring the Gian-I Media archive to six works, and the plan for version 1.0 grows to ten.

sections.metaDescription: Version 0.7 of Gian-I Media publishes all ten planned projects and optimizes the archive’s images.

blocks.metaDescription: All ten projects for version 1.0 go live, and the archive’s images are converted to WebP, compressed, and downscaled.

sections.metaDescription: Version 0.8 rebuilds Gian-I Media on Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with layout and accessibility refinements.

blocks.metaDescription: Rebuilding Gian-I Media as a Next.js app on Vercel with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and the tutorials used to learn them.
Refined spacing and column proportions on work and note pages, improved accessibility, and smoother theme transitions.
Early fragments of a personal stance on design and technology, sparked by GradEx manifestos, touching on craft and nature.
Plans after version 0.8: settle the mobile filter UX, filter by project tools, add grid options, and refine dark mode.

sections.metaDescription: Version 0.9 adds tool filters and refines the colour palettes, alongside a look back at the original Figma designs.

blocks.metaDescription: Filtering by project tools, refined light and dark palettes, and clearer active filter controls in the header.
Screenshots from the original Figma file for Gian-I Media, compared with early layout choices in the current build.

sections.metaDescription: An experimental version 0.925 of Gian-I Media: a weekend of small improvements instead of the planned mobile filter.

blocks.metaTitle: Not The Mobile Filter – Version 0.925 – Birth
blocks.metaDescription: A loosely tested collection of small improvements, built over a weekend instead of the mobile filter that was planned.

sections.metaDescription: Version 1.0 of Gian-I Media adds the mobile filter, a scroll-aware header and footer, and plans for a featured landing page.

blocks.metaDescription: A scroll-aware header and footer, the mobile filter, a reset button, and larger type, plus a plan for a featured landing page.
